SPECIFICATION & FORMULA

Calculation Methodology

PERT Expected Hours = (Optimistic + 4 × Most Likely + Pessimistic) / 6. Standard Deviation σ = (Pessimistic - Optimistic) / 6. 95% Confidence Buffer = Expected + 2σ.

REFERENCE BASIS: Standard Industry Financial & Technical Formula • ASSUMPTIONS VERIFIED: 2026-10-27

Reference Notes & FAQ

Why should fixed-price contracts be quoted at the 95% Confidence level?

Quoting at Expected + 2 Standard Deviations protects your margin against unexpected API changes, scope creep, and edge-case bugs.
